page.meta_description: The facehugger is the first stage that leaps from an egg, clamps a host, and leaves the embryo that will later burst out. Related pages: Xenomorph,…
page.content:
Egg-born parasite that implants a chestburster.

How Facehugger connects

  • Concept: Xenomorph — The facehugger is the implanting stage of the xenomorph cycle.
  • Concept: Chestburster — A facehugger implantation produces a chestburster.

What is Facehugger?

The facehugger is the first stage that leaps from an egg, clamps a host, and leaves the embryo that will later burst out.

Key threads lead to Xenomorph and Chestburster.
